question: Cervical punch biopsy is the primary first-line screening test for cervical cancer and should be performed before a Pap smear in all women over 30 years presenting with post-coital bleeding.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is false. Cervical punch biopsy is a diagnostic (not screening) procedure. It is performed under colposcopic guidance after an abnormal Pap smear, HPV test, or positive VIA — not as a first-line investigation.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is FALSE. Pap smear (cytology) or HPV testing is the first-line screening tool. Punch biopsy is a diagnostic procedure performed under colposcopic guidance only after an abnormal cytology or positive VIA/VILI result.
